definition_title: Normal bases in finite spanning families
natural_language_statement: IsNormalBasis v A means that v restricted to the finite set A is linearly independent and spans the whole vector space. For a finite index type, any nonzero member of a spanning family can be included in some such basis, and every such basis has cardinality equal to the vector-space dimension.
explanation: The provider defines the finite normal-basis condition and proves an extension result for a prescribed nonzero vector in a spanning family. Its cardinality theorem identifies the size of the selected index set with Module.finrank.
